## Main Models to Estimate the ATEs

```{r}
# brms settings
bayes_seed <- 42
chains <- 4
iter <- 4000
warmup <- floor(iter/2)
adapt_delta <- 0.90
max_treedepth <- 10
```

```{r}
# marginaleffects settings
options(marginaleffects_posterior_interval = "hdi")
options(marginaleffects_posterior_center = stats::median)
```

### Model 1 — Primary Model

```{r}
f_m1 <- bf(exp_polpart_pomp ~ exp_condition) 

priors_m1 <- c(
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma"))
```

```{r}
#| output: false
m1 <- brm(
  data = df,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = f_m1,
  prior = priors_m1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "m1.rds")
  )
```

```{r}
print(m1)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

```{r}
m1_pred_avg <- avg_predictions(m1) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) 

m1_pred_avg |> tt()
```

```{r}
m1_pred <- avg_predictions(m1, by = "exp_condition") |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Condition = exp_condition,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) 

m1_pred |> tt()
```

```{r}
m1_comp <- avg_comparisons(m1, variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise")) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

m1_comp |> tt()
```

#### Frequentist comparison

```{r}
f1 <- lm(exp_polpart_pomp ~ exp_condition, data = df)

f1_comp <- avg_comparisons(f1, 
                           variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise")) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Estimate = estimate,
         SE = std.error,
         `p` = p.value,
         "95% CI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% CI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

f1_comp |> tt()
```

#### Quantities of Interest

```{r}
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,

         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

m2_mod_comps |> tt()
```

Treatment effects within each age group:

```{r}
m2_comp <- avg_comparisons(m2, 
                           variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"), 
                           by = "age_group") |> 
  as_tibble() |>

         `Age Group` = age_group,
         Median = estimate,

m2_comp |> tt()
```

Differences in the treatment effects between age groups:

```{r}
m2_comp_diffs <- avg_comparisons(m2,
                                 variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"),
                                 by = "age_group",
                                 hypothesis = difference ~ pairwise | contrast) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         `Age Group Difference` = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

m2_comp_diffs |> tt()
```

### Model 7 — Item-Level Differences

```{r}
df_polpart_items <- df |> 
  select(id, exp_condition, 
         exp_polpart_explain_vote,
         exp_polpart_share_story,
         exp_polpart_send_video,
         exp_polpart_discuss_online,
         exp_polpart_protest) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = exp_polpart_explain_vote:exp_polpart_protest,
    names_to = "item",
    values_to = "response"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    response_pomp = (response - 1) / (5 - 1),  # Convert 1-5 to 0-1
    item = factor(item, 
                  levels = c("exp_polpart_explain_vote",
                             "exp_polpart_share_story",
                             "exp_polpart_send_video",
                             "exp_polpart_discuss_online",
                             "exp_polpart_protest"
                            ),
                  labels = c("ExpVote", "ShareStory", "SendVideo", 
                             "DiscOnl", "Protest"))
  )
```

```{r}
f_m7 <- bf(response_pomp ~ exp_condition * item + (1 | id))

priors_m7 <- c(
  prior(normal(0.5, 0.5), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = "b"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sigma"),
  prior(exponential(2), class = "sd")
)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
m7 <- brm(
  data = df_polpart_items,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = f_m7,
  prior = priors_m7,
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth
  ),
  file = here(model_dir, "m7.rds")
)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

```{r}
# Get posterior predictions 
m7.draws <- expand.grid(
  exp_condition = c("control", "anxiety", "hope"),
  item = levels(df_polpart_items$item)) |>
  add_epred_draws(m7, re_formula = NA) |>
  ungroup()

# Compute item-level pairwise contrasts 
m7.contrasts <- m7.draws |>
  select(exp_condition, item, .draw, .epred) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_condition, values_from = .epred) |>
  mutate(
    `Anxiety - Control` = anxiety - control,
    `Hope - Control` = hope - control,
    `Anxiety - Hope` = anxiety - hope
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Anxiety - Control`, `Hope - Control`, `Anxiety - Hope`),
    names_to = "contrast",
    values_to = "estimate"
  ) |>
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = c("Anxiety - Hope", "Anxiety - Control", "Hope - Control")))
```

```{r}
m7.ate_table <- m7.contrasts |>
  group_by(contrast, .draw) |>
  summarise(estimate = mean(estimate), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(contrast) |>
  median_hdi(estimate, .width = 0.95) |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = .lower,
         "95% HDI Upper" = .upper
  ) 

m7.ate_table |> 
  tt()
```

```{r}
m7.cate_table <- m7.contrasts |>
  group_by(contrast, item) |>
  median_hdi(estimate, .width = 0.95) |> 
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Item = item,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = .lower,
         "95% HDI Upper" = .upper
  ) 

m7.cate_table |> 
  tt()
```

## Exploratory Moderation Models

Moderation of the treatment effects by subjective living standard, age (continuous), and parental ideology. Living standard: difficult and very difficult combined given the small number of respondents in "very difficult" (<5%). Continuous moderators are standardised for estimation; slopes are reported per year of age and per scale point of parental ideology.

```{r}
df_het <- df |>
  mutate(
    living_standard = fct_collapse(
      living_standard,
      Comfortable = levels(living_standard)[1],
      Coping = levels(living_standard)[2],
      Difficult = levels(living_standard)[3:4]
    ) |> fct_rev()
  )

age_mean <- mean(df_het$age)
age_sd <- sd(df_het$age)
to_age_z <- \(x) (x - age_mean) / age_sd

pi_mean <- mean(df_het$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
pi_sd <- sd(df_het$parental_ideology, na.rm = TRUE)
to_pi_z <- \(x) (x - pi_mean) / pi_sd

df_het <- df_het |>
  mutate(age_z = to_age_z(age),
         parental_ideology_z = to_pi_z(parental_ideology))

df_het |> count(living_standard)
```

### Model 9 — Interaction with Age (Continuous)

```{r}
f_m9 <- bf(exp_polpart_pomp ~ exp_condition * age_z)
```

```{r}
#| output: false
m9 <- brm(
  data = df_het,
  family = gaussian(),
  formula = f_m9,
  prior = priors_m1,
  sample_prior = "yes",
  init = "random",
  chains = chains,
  iter = iter,
  warmup = warmup,
  seed = bayes_seed,
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    max_treedepth = max_treedepth),
  file = here(model_dir, "m9.rds")
)
```

```{r}
summary(m9)
```

#### Quantities of Interest

Association of age with political participation (slope), averaged across conditions:

```{r}
m9_mod_slope <- avg_slopes(m9,
                           variables = "age_z",
                           newdata = datagrid(exp_condition = unique)) |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |> 
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) x / age_sd, .names = "{.col} (per year)"),
         across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

m9_mod_slope |> tt()
```

Treatment effects at ages 16, 21, and 26:

```{r}
m9_comp <- comparisons(m9,
                       variables = list(exp_condition = "pairwise"),
                       newdata = datagrid(age_z = to_age_z(c(16, 21, 26)))) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(age = round(age_z * age_sd + age_mean)) |>
  select(Contrast = contrast,
         Age = age,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

m9_comp |> tt()
```

Differences in the age slopes between conditions:

```{r}
m9_slope_diffs <- avg_slopes(m9,
                             variables = "age_z",
                             by = "exp_condition",
                             hypothesis = ~ pairwise) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Contrast = hypothesis,
         Median = estimate,
         "95% HDI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% HDI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) x / age_sd, .names = "{.col} (per year)"),
         across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

m9_slope_diffs |> tt()
```

#### Frequentist comparison

```{r}
f9 <- lm(exp_polpart_pomp ~ exp_condition * age_z, data = df_het)

f9_slope_diffs <- avg_slopes(f9,
                             variables = "age_z",
                             by = "exp_condition",
                             hypothesis = ~ pairwise) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  select(Contrast = hypothesis,
         Estimate = estimate,
         SE = std.error,
         `p` = p.value,
         "95% CI Lower" = conf.low,
         "95% CI Upper" = conf.high
         ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3)))

f9_slope_diffs |> tt()
```
